audit.whatIsWrong: Four missing interactions are unaddressed: (1) her Feline Friendship/You and Me!/Final Chapter sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing; (2) Final Chapter (R) is an interruptible channel Q cancels outright; (3) her W/E/R shields absorb burst; (4) Prowling Projectile and You and Me! apply on-hit, scaling with attack speed, so raw armour misreads the trade.
audit.why: missingInteractions lists all four as applicable-but-unstated for this matchup.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: She can't peel your Q through a shield once she's un-attached to heal — bank it for the dismount, not the passive poke.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Barrier used on chip poke is a shield wasted — Zoomies (E) and You and Me! already answer that damage; save Prismatic Barrier for her R channel window.

edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Prismatic Barrier answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Yuumi You and Me! (W, Attach): 0s cd, always up — untargetable while attached; kill the host or catch the dismount windows. - Her R (100-120s cd) is an interruptible channel — a landed Q cancels it. - Your W is 10-12s — save it for the dismount all-in.

edits.before: Ahead, own the geometry: chip Yuumi's duo per wave and laser the recovery roots.
edits.after: Ahead, punish her R on sight: Final Chapter is a channel and Light Binding cancels it outright — a landed Q ends the heal and opens the dive.

edits.before: Carry by windows — one clean play per fight; your carry does the arithmetic.
edits.after: Prowling Projectile and You and Me! apply on-hit and scale with her host's attack speed — a fed ADC hurts more than the base numbers suggest, so track their items, not just Yuumi's.
